section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1996
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1996 N.C.R.B. (M.H.A.) 3.7.4 The sex-wise break-up & details of percentage distribution of the means adopted for suicide in the various States/UTs & Cities are given in Appendix-VIII. Quite a large number of Female victims resorted to the means such as drowning, self immolation, hanging, consuming poison, inflicting self injury, use of sleeping pills for committing suicide compared to other means.
